items.description: Evidence maturity of the NHL research engine (currently CALIBRATION_BUILDING). EARLY_LEARNING -> CALIBRATION_BUILDING -> EVIDENCE_EMERGING -> VALIDATED, by documented sample and calibration gates; a status, never betting authority. extensions.learning_v1 holds the scorecard.

actual_wagers.note: routed manual wagers are reported only in the accounting ledger / app performance.json; never mixed with research candidates

market_moved_toward_model.ci_note: treats observations as independent; same-game correlation makes the interval too narrow

model_side_clv.ci_note: treats observations as independent; same-game correlation makes the interval too narrow

probability.population: DATA_ONLY_V1 final pregame snapshot per contract (settled)

projection.population: final pregame thesis snapshot per settled game (joint draw expected non-shootout goals)

clv.ci_note: treats observations as independent; same-game correlation makes the interval too narrow

funded_research.note: nominal research stakes (whole dollars, $250 research bankroll); never placed

research_candidates.population: every shortlisted research candidate at the game's final pregame thesis snapshot (shadow: scored whether or not wagered)

clv.ci_note: treats observations as independent; same-game correlation makes the interval too narrow

script_candidates.population: NHL_SCRIPT_V1 research candidates at each game's final pregame snapshot, scored per contract at the executable ask

scripts.population: final pregame NHL_SCRIPT_V1 forecast per settled game

gates.rule: fewer than 100 settled games or 1,000 settled final-pregame contracts
>= 100 settled games and >= 1,000 settled final-pregame contracts

>= 300 settled games, >= 200 settled script forecasts, >= 500 candidate CLV observations, model Brier within 0.005 of the market on final pregame contracts in BOTH halves of the sample, and no family with |calibration bias| > 0.03 at n >= 200

>= 800 settled games (about a full season), >= 600 settled script forecasts, model Brier <= market in both halves, research-candidate mean CLV > 0 with a 95% interval excluding 0 at n >= 1,000, and script forecasts beating the league base rate

stage.label: CALIBRATION BUILDING
stage.note: maturity is a STATUS: it grants no betting authority, and ROI is never a criterion

unknowns: Whether the projection model beats the market: 185 settled games; model vs market Brier difference 0.0029 is within early-season noise.
Whether the opponent adjustment improves betting decisions: it is a RESEARCH layer (walk-forward sanity check only) and is not a model input.

known_limitations: research candidates are scored as shadow positions; actual routed wagers are never mixed in
items.name: NHL model learning stage

limitations: small samples are published with their n; maturity gates never use ROI

items.description: Shot-attempt (Corsi) share with each opponent's offense and defense removed. Weighted ridge regression rate = mu + OFF(team) + DEF(opponent) + home, fit on games before the cutoff (this + last season, recency-weighted). The raw rate on the same games and weights is kept in each observation's extensions.raw_value.

methodology.model: rate_for = mu + OFF_team + DEF_opponent + eta*home, weighted ridge
methodology.status: RESEARCH: walk-forward sanity-checked (docs/research/opponent_adjustment), not validated to VERIFIED; not a DATA_ONLY_V1 input
methodology.weights: ice-time hours x 0.5^(days/60) x 0.6 for last season
methodology.window: current season + previous season, games strictly before the cutoff

known_limitations: opponent adjustment nhl-oppadj-1.0 is a RESEARCH layer: weighted ridge offense/defense effects on 5v5 rates, walk-forward sanity-checked only, not a DATA_ONLY_V1 input; special teams and save percentage are not adjusted
